fusions.name: Parted Water
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of water that deals 7 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of the original damage. It holds 4 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Twin Jets
fusions.desc: Looses 2 jets of water at once, spread apart, each dealing 14 damage and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Diverted Current
fusions.desc: Strings a wall of water 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Second Look
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
